title: David Menkin Talks GTA 6 Launch and Gaming Industry Career
description: Actor David Menkin discusses his career, joining the gaming industry, voicing Pragmata, and sharing his thoughts on the launch of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## David Menkin Discusses GTA 6 Launch and Gaming Career

In a recent episode of Pause for Thought, multifaceted actor David Menkin sat down with host Naomi to discuss his extensive career. From his early beginnings in broadcasting to establishing himself as a prominent voice actor in the video game industry, Menkin shared valuable insights into his journey, including his role as the "space dad" in Capcom's upcoming title *Pragmata*.

### From Broadcasting to the Gaming Industry

Menkin reflected on how he got his start in broadcasting before seamlessly transitioning into the gaming sector. His versatility as an actor has allowed him to take on a wide array of roles, most notably portraying the "space dad" character in *Pragmata*. His career highlights the growing crossover between traditional performance mediums and the modern video game landscape.

### Reflecting on GTA 6 and Industry Giants

During the conversation, Menkin touched upon several major highlights of his professional year. A key topic of discussion was the launch of GTA 6, highlighting the massive cultural and industrial ripple effects that Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece has across the entire gaming community, including industry professionals. He also opened up about what it is like to collaborate with some of the biggest names and studios in the entertainment industry today.

### Personal Gaming Favorites on PS5

Beyond his professional endeavors, Menkin shared a glimpse into his personal gaming habits, revealing some of his favorite PS5 games. This personal touch offered fans a relatable perspective on an actor who brings so many virtual worlds to life.

## Editor's Take

David Menkin's interview provides a fascinating look behind the scenes of modern game development and performance capture. While he didn't drop major in-game secrets regarding *GTA 6*, his perspective as an industry insider underscores just how monumental the game's launch is expected to be across the entire gaming ecosystem.
